decisions.reason: The source refines the Hero V arm relationship and silhouette. It does not change the deferred E/L construction principles or their supporting role.
The requirement that the closing V derive from the Hero V's shared geometry remains valid unchanged. Its current state contains no concrete arm geometry made stale by this refinement.
The accent's continuing derivation from Hero V geometry remains unchanged, and its state contains no specific arm-weight or arm-length value requiring replacement.
The source changes structural V geometry but does not alter the deferred champagne-metal direction, material role, or application constraint.
Refining the Hero V silhouette does not change the deferred requirement that the complete wordmark read as one cohesive mark.
The match is incidental; Hero V geometry has no effect on accepted review-image formats or file accessibility.
